content.jointProblem: Can a regression-kriging workflow using existing grid samples and proximal sensing predict small saline-sodic pockets near the Tisa before field sampling, so that denser sampling is targeted only to variable zones?

rationale.text: Kosanović has direct geostatistical mapping expertise for saline-sodic soils in Vojvodina.

sources.quote: focusing on geostatistical mapping of saline-sodic soils in the Vojvodina plain

rationale.text: He combines EM38, pXRF and soil sampling into spatial models of EC, pH, ESP and texture, matching TloCare's need to map salinity pockets.

sources.quote: combining electromagnetic induction surveys, portable XRF measurements, and soil sampling to build spatial models of physico-chemical properties

rationale.text: His regression-kriging work with EM38 and pXRF shows proximal sensing can reduce expensive laboratory analyses for saline-sodic soil unit mapping.

sources.quote: combining two proximal sensing methods as regression covariates reduces the number of expensive laboratory analyses needed for reliable soil unit mapping

rationale.text: He has published guidance on sample-size reduction and conditioned Latin hypercube designs, which fits the company's need to sample only variable zones.

sources.quote: conditioned Latin hypercube designs with 40–50 soil cores are a reasonable compromise between cost and mapping accuracy

rationale.text: He has delivered ECe and ESP mapping products for practical variable-rate amendment decisions.

sources.quote: delivering ECe and ESP maps used for variable-rate gypsum application

rationale.text: He prefers genuine field data collection, which aligns with TloCare's field-sampling service model.

sources.quote: He prefers collaborations that involve genuine field data collection rather than purely computational work.

rationale.text: His group has day-to-day access to EM38, pXRF and open-source geostatistical software.

sources.quote: regularly uses a Geonics EM38 terrain conductivity meter, a portable XRF analyser, and open-source geostatistical software environments
